title: track.transpose_span changes Q on spans it doesn't touch
description: Applying steer's top suggestion (track.transpose_span bright bars 39-40 value 0) on examples/ave-emerge.apr, window 33-40, also changed the heard Q on the untouched spans: i7 0.950 to 0.925, iv7 0.965 to 0.889. The op splits the track into several 'track bright ... as <alias>' blocks; suspect a side effect of the split, e.g. each block restarting the loop's pattern at its own first bar, duplicated automation or effects, or level differences between blocks. Reproduce: render the window with and without the op and compare the bright stem outside bars 39-40 sample by sample; they should be identical there.
